entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Inca Empire, a political institution in Chile during Inca Expansion and Spanish Conquest (1470–1536). Grew from Chile becomes southern frontier of Tawantinsuyu. Led to the emergence of Inca and Inca expansion halted by Mapuche at the Battle of the Maule c. 1485.
